item.title: MacPass 0.8.3.3
item.description:
Changes since 0.8.3.2:

  • History: Auto-Type without Screen Recording, 0.8.3.2
  • Stretch the toolbar search field to the Lock button again
  • History: toolbar search field to the Lock button
  • History: toolbar search field drag and full-screen tests
  • Point Help and the About box at the fork's repository
  • Drop links to macpass.app; fetch the plugin list from the fork's repository
  • README: don't link macpass.app
  • History: repo website setting cleared
